## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: aws-verify-live.sh runs all 7 checks from SC10 table and exits 0 only if all pass ← Satisfies: sc-10
- DD2: Each failed check emits a named FAIL: <check-name> line to stderr ← Satisfies: sc-10
- DD3: Script reads resource names from dso-config.conf (not hardcoded) ← Satisfies: sc-10
- DD4: After aws-teardown.sh runs, aws-verify-live.sh exits non-zero with per-check status indicating resources absent, and the end-to-end POST check times out within 5 seconds ← Satisfies: sc-10

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && bash "$REPO_ROOT/tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD" || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" || true
- [ ] plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh exists and is executable (chmod +x)
  Verify: test -x $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh
- [ ] Script reads all 4 required config keys from .claude/dso-config.conf: review_telemetry.lambda_function_name, review_telemetry.iam_role_name, review_telemetry.bucket_name, review_telemetry.endpoint_url
  Verify: grep -q "review_telemetry" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh
- [ ] Missing config key causes exit 1 with key name in message
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "test_missing_config_key"
- [ ] All 7 checks pass → exit 0
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "test_all_checks_pass"
- [ ] Any failed check → exit non-zero with FAIL: <check-name> on stderr
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "test_any_check_fail"
- [ ] E2E healthcheck uses poll-with-backoff loop (not single shot) with 60s total budget
  Verify: grep -q "backoff\|sleep\|poll\|TIMEOUT" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh
- [ ] Post-teardown: E2E check times out within 5s (curl --connect-timeout or equivalent used)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "test_e2e_timeout"
- [ ] .test-index entry added mapping plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh to tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh
  Verify: grep -q "plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Implementation Notes

### Script: plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh

**Config reading pattern** (use the same read-config.sh pattern as other scripts):
```bash
REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
CONF="$REPO_ROOT/.claude/dso-config.conf"
_cfg() { grep "^${1}=" "$CONF" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2- | head -1; }
FN_NAME=$(_cfg "review_telemetry.lambda_function_name")
ROLE_NAME=$(_cfg "review_telemetry.iam_role_name")
BUCKET_NAME=$(_cfg "review_telemetry.bucket_name")
ENDPOINT_URL=$(_cfg "review_telemetry.endpoint_url")
```

**Missing key guard** (check each key before running any checks):
```bash
for key_var in FN_NAME ROLE_NAME BUCKET_NAME ENDPOINT_URL; do
    [[ -z "${!key_var}" ]] && echo "Missing config key: review_telemetry.${key_var,,}" >&2 && exit 1
done
```

**Per-check pattern** — each check is a function:
```bash
check_pass=0
check_fail_names=()
_run_check() {
    local name="$1"; shift
    if "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "PASS: $name"
    else
        echo "FAIL: $name" >&2
        check_fail_names+=("$name")
        check_pass=1
    fi
}
```

**7 checks to implement** (check names for FAIL: lines):
1. `lambda-function-url` — `aws lambda get-function-url-config --function-name "$FN_NAME"`; assert FunctionUrl populated
2. `iam-role` — `aws iam get-role --role-name "$ROLE_NAME"`; assert trust policy includes lambda.amazonaws.com
3. `s3-head-bucket` — `aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET_NAME"`
4. `s3-encryption` — `aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket "$BUCKET_NAME"`
5. `s3-lifecycle` — `aws s3api get-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket "$BUCKET_NAME"`; assert 90d Glacier IR rule present
6. `iam-simulate` — `aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn "$ROLE_ARN" --action-names s3:PutObject --resource-arns "arn:aws:s3:::$BUCKET_NAME/*"` → pipe to python3/jq to assert EvalDecision=allowed
7. `e2e-healthcheck` — poll-with-backoff loop: curl POST to $ENDPOINT_URL with --connect-timeout 4 --max-time 5; poll `aws s3 ls s3://$BUCKET_NAME/dso-self/` within 60s budget

**End-to-end check implementation**:
```bash
_e2e_healthcheck() {
    local budget=60 interval=3 elapsed=0
    # POST healthcheck event
    if ! curl --connect-timeout 4 --max-time 5 -sf -X POST "$ENDPOINT_URL" \
         -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
         -d '{"schema_version":1,"event_type":"review_cycle","client_id":"dso-self","event_id":"verify-healthcheck"}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        return 1
    fi
    # Poll S3 for object arrival (60s budget with backoff)
    while (( elapsed < budget )); do
        if aws s3 ls "s3://$BUCKET_NAME/dso-self/" 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then
            return 0
        fi
        sleep "$interval"
        (( elapsed += interval ))
        (( interval = interval < 10 ? interval + 2 : 10 ))
    done
    return 1
}
```

**Exit behavior**: `exit ${check_pass}` at end (0 if all passed, 1 if any failed)

**Post-teardown behavior**: The `--connect-timeout 4 --max-time 5` flags on curl ensure fast failure when endpoint is gone (≤5s). The poll loop exits immediately if curl fails (before entering the S3 poll loop).

### .test-index update
Add this line to .test-index:
```
plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh: tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh
```
(Fuzzy match would NOT catch "aws-verify-live.sh" from "test-aws-verify-live.sh" reliably due to "live" suffix — explicit .test-index entry is required.)

Note: "awsverifylive" IS a substring of "testawsverifylive" — fuzzy match DOES work here. But adding explicit .test-index entry provides additional safety.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
